_audit_r18_corpus_identity_2026_09_15.what: The gate RAN here for the first time, and its FAIL must not be read as a code regression. scripts/source_elab_gate.sh discovered its corpus through a glob hardcoded to `$HOME/mathlib4-*`, so on every box but one it skipped `no-corpus` for a reason that had nothing to do with whether a corpus was present. Fixing the glob to honour $HOME made it run -- and it returned SRCELAB_GATE=failed:ratchet-regression against a DIFFERENT Mathlib.

corpus_armed.note: from this artifact's `notes` prose, now also machine-readable in `corpus`

_audit_r18_corpus_identity_2026_09_15.why_this_is_not_a_regression: Two independent confirmations, neither relying on the other. (1) GIT: 43ad0e9d2e14 is not a commit in $HOME/mathlib4-pinned at all -- `git rev-parse --verify` finds no object -- so it is a different history, not a different checkout state of the same one. (2) SOURCE TEXT: decl_count is a property of the pinned file's own declarations, and three of the five differ from the armed values (Data/Subtype 45->47, Logic/Basic 255->257, Logic/Function/Basic 226->219). A file with a different number of declarations is a different file. Per-file success counts across two corpora are not comparable in EITHER direction, so this run is evidence about neither the elaborator nor the baselines.
_audit_r18_corpus_identity_2026_09_15.what_changed_in_the_gate: Corpus identity is now recorded and compared rather than assumed. The report carries a `corpus` block (dir/rev/toolchain), this artifact carries a `corpus` pin, and an armed run against a corpus that does not match the pin returns SRCELAB_GATE=skipped:corpus-mismatch -- refused in a pre-flight before the measurement is spent, with the finalize check as the backstop. An armed ratchet with NO corpus pin is failed:corpus-unpinned, because baselines that cannot say what they are counts OF were never falsifiable. Moving the pin requires `--update --repin-corpus '<why>'`, which records the move in `corpus_repins`; without that gesture --update on a foreign corpus re-arms nothing, so the pin cannot launder its own basis (the data/spine_scoreboard.json lesson of 2026-09-14).
_audit_r18_corpus_identity_2026_09_15.what_this_does_NOT_excuse: The Order/Basic regression recorded in _audit_r17_remeasurement_2026_09_02 STANDS and is untouched by this.
